owned-content.measure_layout: Component.measure required; optional arrange; existing measured layout primitives
owned-content.paint_clip_theme: Content traversal propagates ancestor clip, Palette and canonical inherited Surface. Surface changes clear inherited foreground/icon foreground so they resolve from the new surface; foreground forwarding remains explicit through child_theme/component rules, not automatic for arbitrary descendants.
owned-content.events_focus: Original Content routes the topmost target then ancestors. Unhandled ordinary events bubble; handled stops by default and supports explicit instance/per-event opt-in. Capture and original action identity retained; modal, IME and focus traversal remain barriers.
owned-content.state_lifecycle: owned object + ComponentId; reorder moves objects; insert/remove Mounted/Unmounted; explicit retained returned subtree; no automatic reconstruction/virtualization
owned-content.invalidation: event response, focus/mutation dirty; render acknowledges; animation uses existing host clock/frame request
owned-content.semantics: actual mounted active tree and parts, role/name/value/state/frame/action; ContentRole and macOS bridge already exist; independent native example and Gallery both export semantics; full family Inspector/VoiceOver acceptance remains separate Declarative required metadata is distinct from disabled/read-only/invalid and native experience acceptance.
owned-content.limits: Any + Box<dyn Component> requires owned static objects; optional methods default; no claim of borrowed/static DSL/full-library conversion; input/focus/AX-action boundaries reconcile active ancestor paths before dispatch.
